tools.name: create_node
tools.description:
Deploy a new blockchain node. Call get_deployment_options first for valid IDs.

Trader nodes are region-bound (e.g., London, Ashburn, Singapore). Always confirm
the region with the user before deploying — region cannot be changed after deployment.

Args:

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "contact_chainstack" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Submit a message to Chainstack's sales and support team. Use when the user wants to ask about pricing, get a custom quote, request a plan upgrade, request node …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "contact_chainstack" references sensitive artifacts (private key, password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_nodes, get_project, get_doc_page, contact_chainstack, request_testnet_funds, get_chainstack_pricing · Private data: contact_chainstack, request_testnet_funds, get_chainstack_pricing · Public sink: contact_chainstack, request_testnet_funds · Destructive: delete_project, delete_node, request_testnet_funds.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_nodes, get_project, get_doc_page, contact_chainstack, request_testnet_funds, get_chainstack_pricing · Private data: contact_chainstack, request_testnet_funds, get_chainstack_pricing · Public sink: contact_chainstack, request_testnet_funds · Destructive: delete_project, delete_node, request_testnet_funds

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
